answer: Auction a fixed number of subsidy tickets and permit each ticket to be redeemed once, regardless of the name presenting it. Agents trading timber or saffron must pay the same clearing price; a spiral of new accounts creates no new tickets. An attacker seeking 1,000 earning slots must buy 1,000 scarce tickets, raising the price as demand grows. Keep the maximum subsidy below the ticket cost to remove signup-farming profit. This sacrifices free entry and does not prevent a wealthy bidder from concentrating access.
